info.description: Development only. Set baseUrl, adminEmail and adminPassword for an existing administrator. Each run creates 3 uniquely named demonstration users, promotes two to editor, exercises every endpoint and cleans up created learning content. Demo users remain because there is no account-deletion endpoint. See docs/API_TESTING.md.
